steps.code:
# Let's fetch the latest message for each friend and parse RSVP
friend_phones = {
 "Cory": "5412564532",
 "Edwin": "8506051563",
 "Glenn": "8638518861",
 "Anita": "3643463570",
 "Debra": "3375602296",
 "Morgan": "8903665635",
 "Kevin": "3654328626",
 "Kristin": "6017026518",
 "Melissa": "3383946795",
 "Norman": "5708520672",
 "Robin": "5025995878"
}

rsvps = {}
for name, phone in friend_phones.items():
    resp = apis.phone.search_text_messages(access_token=phone_token, phone_number=phone, only_latest_per_contact=True, page_limit=20)
    # The response is a list; take the first (latest) message
    if resp:
        msg = resp[0]["message"].lower()
        # Determine RSVP based on keywords
        if "can't" in msg or "cannot" in msg or "not" in msg or "no" in msg or "won't" in msg or "decline" in msg:
            rsvps[name] = "no"
        elif "yes" in msg or "coming" in msg or "will" in msg or "join" in msg or "attend" in msg:
            rsvps[name] = "yes"
        else:
            rsvps[name] = "unknown"
    else:
        rsvps[name] = "unknown"
    print(f"{name}: {msg if resp else 'no message'} -> {rsvps[name]}")

print(rsvps)
